source_title: 123Invent Inventor Develops New Independent Suspension for Side-By-Sides & UTV's
source_excerpt:
PITTSBURGH, Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Side-by-side vehicles are known for their incredible off-road capabilities, largely made possible by their suspension design. However, the main limitation is exposed when these vehicles receive an impact at an angle that the suspension cannot absorb. The traditional independent suspension only allows the wheel to move in a single direction when absorbing an impact. This leaves tremendous room for improvement, so development began on a project, code-named Omni-Flex Suspension, which is a revolutionary new design that allows the wheel to move in any direction. This design will offer the next step in the evolution of independent suspension.
The patent-pending invention provides an improved independent suspension system for UTV's, side-by-sides, and pickup trucks. In doing so, it allows the wheels to move in any direction. As a result, it reduces impact when encountering a bump while driving. Thus, it improves the ride quality. The invention features a practical design that is easy to install and use so it is ideal for the owners and manufacturers of UTV's, side-by-sides, pickup trucks, etc.
The OMNI-FLEX SUSPENSION is currently available for licensing or sale to manufacturers or marketers. For more information, visit www.omni-flexsuspension.com . Or contact James Russell at 859-519-0050 or email [email protected] .
